raw.description:
Overview

Axway, Inc. seeks Senior Services Consultant I (Scottsdale, AZ)

Job Description: Determine an organization’s network and system needs and install operating and application hardware and software. Install and configure Axway API Management solutions (API Manager, API Gateway, Cassandra) across high-availability environments including AWS Cloud, Linux servers, Kubernetes, and Docker, ensuring secure API traffic routing compliant with enterprise architecture standards. Design and configure database environments integrating MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Apache Cassandra to support API transaction monitoring, storage, and seamless data exchange across enterprise systems. Deploy APIs across cloud, SaaS, and legacy systems while leading Axway platform upgrades to maintain latest updates, continuously improve client environments. Ensure operational excellence of API Management solutions through continuous optimization, stability verification, and interoperability testing, utilizing integrated Datadog and Splunk monitoring platforms for comprehensive API health observability. Architect AI workflow solutions using Amplify Fusion to scale AI initiatives and establish secure, compliant integrations between AI agents and business-critical applications. Provide formal training and informal mentorship to equip clients with technical knowledge to maximize Axway API Manager, API Gateway, Engage, and Amplify Fusion solutions. Deploy and manage Amplify Engage to federate API governance across multi-cloud environments, centralizing API catalogs, onboarding developer communities, and enforcing enterprise-wide compliance standards.

Telecommuting permitted. Reports to headquarters in Scottsdale, AZ.

Job Requirements: Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology and Management, or related and 2 years of related experience. Must have some experience in each of the following skills: Operating system and application administration with Windows or Linux-based environments; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) tools source control, build systems, issue tracking, and requirements management; Web API development in SOAP, XML, REST, JSON, and REST-based API testing; Database administration and management with Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL and Cassandra; Cloud and container-based technologies including AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes; Web communication technologies including HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and X509 standards; and Web application security and federated identity standards including SAML, WS-Fed, WS-Trust, OAuth, OpenID, and XACML.

EOE.

To apply, email resume to Candace Kappelman, referencing Req. # 315.

Job Purpose

The Role

This is not a typical enterprise software sales role.

We're seeking a commercially driven hunter with deep expertise in regulated industries, a strong professional network, and a proven ability to open doors, build executive relationships, and win new business.

You'll be responsible for developing your own pipeline, identifying high-potential target accounts, and leading complex enterprise sales opportunities from prospecting through to close.

Working closely with Marketing, Presales, Product, and Customer Success teams, you'll help shape TimeArc's growth strategy whilst delivering measurable revenue impact.

About TimeArc

TimeArc helps organizations manage, govern, and deliver complex, high-value content where accuracy, traceability, version control, and regulatory confidence are essential.

The solution serves specialized markets including audit and accounting, tax, and standards and regulatory organizations.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a new-logo sales strategy for TimeArc within assigned industries and territories.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized target-account plan based on industry knowledge, market relationships, and commercial potential.
  • Engage senior business, content, methodology, technology, compliance, and innovation leaders.
  • Lead discovery conversations that connect content challenges to revenue, efficiency, risk, regulatory requirements, and AI readiness.
  • Develop compelling business cases that demonstrate the financial and operational value of TimeArc.
  • Manage the complete enterprise sales cycle, from account development and qualification through solution validation, commercial negotiation, and close.
  • Partner closely with BDRs, Marketing, Presales, Product, Customer Success, and executive sponsors.
  • Coordinate industry campaigns, events, webinars, partner activity, and account-based marketing programs.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity data, next steps, close dates, risks, and forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Use MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise qualification framework to assess and advance opportunities.
  • Provide structured market feedback to Product and Marketing on buyer needs, competitive activity, messaging, and emerging use cases.
  • Develop trusted relationships that create opportunities for long-term customer growth.

Skills & Experience

  • Sales Background: Proven success selling enterprise technology, information solutions, or professional services into:

    • Audit & accounting firms

    • Tax advisory firms, corporate tax functions, or government tax authorities

    • Standards development & regulatory organizations

  • Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of target buyers, operating models, terminology, priorities, and purchasing processes.

  • Networking & Targeting: An established professional network with the ability to identify credible target accounts and buyer personas.

  • Business Development: Success driving new business, generating opportunities, and managing complex, long enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Value-Based Selling: Experience developing business cases, engaging business/technical stakeholders, and translating technical features into business outcomes.

  • Core Sales Execution: Strong discovery, executive communication, negotiation, opportunity management, pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and consistent quota achievement.

  • Collaboration: Comfortable working within an international, cross-functional team environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Domain & Tech Exposure: Background in content tech, structured content, knowledge management, workflow, compliance, AI, or digital transformation.

  • Specialized Knowledge: Familiarity with audit trails, effective dates, point-in-time content, content governance, metadata, jurisdictional complexity, and explainable AI.

  • Sales Methodology & Tools: Experience using Salesforce, account-based selling, and MEDDPICC.

  • Key Relationships: Pre-existing relationships with senior decision-makers in the target industries.

What Success Looks Like

During the first six months, the successful candidate will:

  • Develop a focused territory and target-account plan.
  • Activate existing industry relationships and create new executive-level conversations.
  • Build qualified pipeline across the assigned TimeArc verticals.
  • Establish a clear point of view on the business problems TimeArc solves.
  • Work with Marketing and the BDR team to improve industry messaging and campaign performance.
  • Progress qualified opportunities through a disciplined and visible sales process.

Longer term, success will be measured by:

  • New-logo bookings
  • Qualified pipeline creation
  • Forecast accuracy

Content is becoming increasingly important to AI, regulatory compliance, customer experience, and enterprise decision-making. TimeArc provides organizations with the structure, governance, traceability, and control needed to use critical information confidently.

This is an opportunity to help build a focused growth business, shape its market strategy, and bring a differentiated solution to industries where trustworthy content directly affects business performance.

raw.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Due to Granicus’ continued growth, the Business Development Team is seeking new team members who will work to identify potential customers, further our partnerships with existing clients and increase the adoption of modern government technology throughout the country. The Business Development Representative is responsible for prospecting, qualifying, and generating new sales opportunities to help support the Federal, State and Local Sales teams. They will partner with Sales Executives to set up discovery meetings and opportunities with key decision makers in the government. These opportunities will be generated through qualifying inbound marketing campaign leads and strategic outbound communication. This role is for a highly-motivated, ambitious, and results driven individual. Through strategic partnerships with members of the Sales and Marketing Teams, Business Development Representatives will be exposed to a variety of roles and experiences. This will help develop the skills and business acumen needed to become a top-tier sales professional in the GovTech sector and build a successful career.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Develop new business via phone and email to educate and introduce the prospect to the Granicus platform
  • Conduct initial qualification and discover prospect's current environment, pain points, and potential projects
  • Identify appropriate key buying influencers within the target market and their established budget and timeline
  • Follow up with inbound marketing leads and outbound prospects through a strategic outreach plan to generate additional interest in Granicus and qualify for a potential opportunity
  • Build and cultivate prospect relationships by initiating communications and conducting follow-up communications in order to move opportunities through the sales funnel
  • Collaborate with account executives to create strategic territory plans and develop and grow the sales pipeline to consistently meet quarterly revenue goals
  • Use Salesforce CRM to properly track all sales activities and manage contact/lead data for accuracy
  • Analyze sales pipeline reports and dashboards
  • Other duties as assigned

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • You have work and/ or internships experience in sales or marketing, or a degree in business, communications, or another related field
  • You have 1+ year of relevant work experience
  • You can meet and/or exceed set sales and activity metrics
  • You can build strong client relationships
  • You have excellent written and oral communication skills
  • You have effective problem solving, time management, and organizational skills
  • You are proficient in MS Office products
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM Software preferred

Pay Range

USD $50,000.00 - USD $50,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.
  • A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices
  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.
  • Company-Wide Wellbeing Days – Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health.
  • Work From Home Reimbursement – Support a productive home office environment.
Health & Wellness
  • Multiple Health Plan Options – Including a 100% employer-paid plan.
  • Employer HSA Contributions – When enrolled in a High-Deductible Health Plan.
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program – Stay active, your way.
  • On-Demand Mental Health Support – Access to Headspace and other wellness tools.
Family & Future
  • Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
  • Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
  • Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Campaign Strategy and Planning:
  • Collaborate with clients or internal teams to define advertising goals and objectives.

  • Determine target audiences, budget allocation, and ad types.
Ad Creation and Design:
  • Create visually appealing and compelling ad creatives (images, videos, copy) that resonate with the target audience.

  • Set up and manage Facebook ad campaigns, including ad sets and individual ads.
  • Continuously monitor campaign performance, making adjustments as needed to optimize results.
Audience Targeting:
  • Utilize Facebook's targeting options to reach the most relevant audience segments.
  • Test and refine audience targeting parameters based on campaign performance data.
Ad Budget Management:
  • Allocate and manage ad budgets effectively to ensure the best ROI.
  • Monitor ad spend to stay within the allocated budget.
Ad Performance Analysis:
  • Regularly analyze key performance metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, cost per click (CPC), and return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Use analytics tools to assess the effectiveness of campaigns.
A/B Testing:
  • Plan and execute A/B tests to assess the impact of different ad elements, including headlines, visuals, and ad copy.
Conversion Tracking:
  • Set up and manage conversion tracking to measure the impact of Facebook ads on website or landing page goals.
Campaign Reporting:
  • Prepare and present regular reports on campaign performance and ROI to clients or internal stakeholders.
  • Offer insights and recommendations for optimization.
Stay Updated:
  • Keep up with the latest trends, tools, and changes in Facebook's advertising platform.
  • Implement best practices and strategies for achieving advertising objectives.

Requirements

Digital Marketing Expertise:
  • Proven experience in digital marketing and, specifically, in managing Facebook ad campaigns.
  • Familiarity with other digital advertising platforms is a plus.
Analytical Skills:
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills to make informed decisions based on campaign performance data.
Creativity:
  • The ability to create engaging ad content and visuals that resonate with target audiences.
Technical Proficiency:
  • Proficiency in using Facebook Ads Manager and related advertising tools.
  • Knowledge of ad tracking and analytics tools is essential.
Communication Skills:
  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with clients or team members and present campaign results.
Budget Management:
  • Experience in managing advertising budgets and optimizing ad spend.
Problem-Solving Skills:
  • Ability to identify issues and opportunities for improvement in ad campaigns and develop solutions.
Certifications:
  • Facebook Blueprint Certification or other relevant certifications can be an advantage.
Adaptability:
  • The ability to adapt to changes in the Facebook advertising platform and industry trends.
Organizational Skills:
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to be a part of a dynamic growth focused tech startup.
  • Great learning opportunities to develop new skills and understanding of cutting edge software tools and processes.
  • Opportunity to work closely with serial tech entrepreneurs from Silicon Valley.
  • Fun-loving environment and caring team mates and inclusive culture of the company.

raw.description:
Join North Wind - Accelerating Hypersonic Innovation

At North Wind, we are advancing hypersonic technologies through cutting-edge research, system development, and flight testing. Our team drives innovation in high-speed aerodynamics, propulsion systems, and mission-critical components, supporting every phase of hypersonic programs - from R&D to flight testing, If you are passionate about pushing technological boundaries in a dynamic environment, we invite you to join us.

Senior GenAI Solutions Architect:

Are you an innovator who thrives on solving complex problems with Generative AI, agentic systems, and advanced deep learning? North Wind is seeking a Senior GenAI Solutions Architect who can design and scale intelligent, multi-agent pipelines that accelerate aerospace engineering workflows; ranging from automated data pipelines to reduced‑order modeling of high‑fidelity computational fluid dynamics simulations. This role focuses on building secure, scalable GenAI architectures that operate seamlessly across IL2 to IL7 cloud platforms to support defense missions and digital engineering initiatives.

North Wind is looking for a seasoned, technically strong GenAI Solutions Architect to accelerate DoD customers’ adoption of generative and agentic AI. In this role, you will lead engagements with key defense partners, understand their mission and technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that leverage multi‑agent orchestration, advanced deep learning techniques, and secure data integration. You will collaborate across North Wind’s digital engineering and data science ecosystem, working with cross‑functional teams and customers to deliver mission‑aligned, impactful outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serving as a trusted, customer-facing technical advisor who champions GenAI and agentic solutions across IL2–IL7 environments, guiding customers through secure, cloud‑agnostic architectures.
  • Define and design solutions leveraging AWS and Azure GenAI services, lead technical workshops and demonstrations, and contribute to best practices and reference architectures for advanced deep learning and digital engineering within the DoD.
  • Stay current with advancements in GenAI, multi-agent systems, and aerospace-focused AI techniques is essential to driving mission success.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, becoming an evangelist for GenAI solutions both within the company and customer facing roles.
  • Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure development and deployments in a cloud-agnostic methodology, working alongside North Wind IT staff and infrastructure engineers to maintain capable and secure systems.
  • Work with customers and teammates to define and architect solutions that leverage AWS GenAI services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker Studio, Amazon Titan Embeddings, etc.) to address their most critical challenges.
  • Work with customers and teammates to define and architect solutions that leverage and integrate with Azure GenAI services (AI Studio, AI Foundry, etc.)
  • Lead technical workshops and demonstrations with customers to showcase the capabilities of NorthWind's platform and AI technologies.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices and reference architectures for GenAI in the DoD.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in GenAI and related technologies.

Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in cloud‑native architecture, deep learning, and Generative AI, with hands‑on experience designing and deploying secure solutions across IL2–IL7 environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience architecting and deploying cloud-based solutions.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with machine learning technologies and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLFlow, etc.).
  • Experience working with large datasets and data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles and best practices, especially IL4-7 and CMMC 2.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrate expertise with AWS and Azure AI services, proficiency in developing agentic and multi‑agent systems, and a proven ability to translate complex mission requirements into scalable, production‑ready architectures.
  • Master’s degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Experience with developing and training Generative AI models and techniques (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models).
  • Experience with Amazon SageMaker Studio and other AWS machine learning services.
  • Experience with Azure AI and data ecosystem tools, including Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, and related Azure data lake, data pipeline, and MLOps services.
  • Expertise designing or optimizing reduced‑order models, physics‑informed neural networks, or other advanced deep learning techniques for aerospace or defense engineering workloads.
  • Experience working in the DoD or public sector.
  • Active security clearance (e.g., Secret, Top Secret).
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certification.
  • Demonstrated commitment to staying current on emerging GenAI, digital engineering, and aerospace‑focused AI advancements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical workshops, influence stakeholders, and drive adoption of modern GenAI practices within complex DoD organizations.
  • Familiarity with secure DevSecOps practices, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code workflows commonly used in defense cloud environments.

Desired Characteristics

  • Thrives in a fast‑paced, agile environment and is comfortable working within a distributed, cross‑time zone team.
  • Actively engage on collaborative communication channels such as Slack, Teams, and Confluence, and are willing to jump into rapid‑response “tiger teams” when mission needs arise.
  • Demonstrates a strong willingness to learn, embraces iterative development, and consistently contributes to team success.
  • Think creatively to solve complex AI/ML challenges while adhering to North Wind’s security boundaries and DevSecOps principles, and they communicate effectively with engineers, program managers, and executive leadership alike.

North Wind is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. North Wind supports safe and drug free workplace through pre-employment background checks and drug testing.

The salary range provided is a general guideline. Actual pay will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, education, experience, training, and other applicable qualifications. North Wind is committed to pay transparency in compliance with applicable state and local laws.

All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.

title: Contracts Specialist
description: Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery.

raw.title: Contracts Specialist
raw.excerpt: Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery.
raw.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery. Solid contracts set the terms, expectations, and guardrails that let our teams do great, uninterrupted work. As Avicado grows, the Contracts Specialist is one of the key support pillars that keeps that backbone strong. You keep our contracts reviewed, signed on terms we can stand behind, easy to find, and easy to understand, so Finance, our consultants, Sales, and leadership can do their work with confidence.

Core Responsibilities

Contract Review and Risk Screening

  • Act as the first-line reviewer for contracts, amendments, and RFPs from Sales and internal teams, including client, partner, vendor, and IT agreements.
  • Identify the terms that carry real risk, say what each could cost us, and recommend how to respond, including redlines within our standard positions.
  • Coordinate redlines and approvals between Sales and leadership, and elevate terms outside our standard positions, so every contract has a clear status and a clear next step.
  • Support internal teams with risk questions on software and IT agreements and client security questionnaires.
  • Own the insurance requirements in contracts: be the first stop for internal questions, coordinate the annual insurance renewal with our broker, and back up the Biz Ops Coordinator on certificate of insurance (COI) requests.

Contracts Database and Lifecycle

  • Build and maintain the central Contracts Database. A contract is not done until it is stored with its key dates, terms, and obligations.
  • Keep the data accurate and complete: check entries regularly, fix errors at the source, and document how entries are made so teammates can add to the database correctly.
  • Record renewal, notice, and termination terms when a contract is stored, so Sales, who own renewals, know the terms, the paper the contract is on, and whether anything new needs to be put in place.
  • Own the termination process: when Directors or Sales decide to end an agreement, review the contract if its terms are not already in the database, define how it gets terminated, and hold the team accountable for the steps.
  • Grow what the database captures over time so the team can answer questions about terms and obligations without reopening the contract, and so leadership can see risk in aggregate across all of our contracts.

Templates

  • Own our contract templates: decide what goes into them, get our Legal team's feedback, and update the templates once a change is approved.
  • Maintain the template change request process so every request gets a clear answer and the requester can see its status.
  • Keep one current version of each template in one place, and make sure out-of-date copies are not in use.
  • Work with Sales so they understand which terms carry little risk and can be adjusted, and which carry operational or business risk and should not change without review.
  • Identify template gaps and get them closed.

Ideal Background

Should have

  • Hands-on experience reviewing professional services agreements, such as MSAs, SOWs, and change orders, ideally in a consulting or implementation environment.
  • Working knowledge of common risk terms: indemnification, limitation of liability, SLAs, data and privacy, and insurance requirements.
  • Experience building or maintaining a contract repository or tracker and keeping it accurate over time, not only using one.
  • Experience carrying a template or process change through to adoption across teams that do not report to you.
  • A calculated view of risk: you size it, recommend a response, and let decision-makers weigh it against the value of the deal, rather than treating risk as something to avoid or forwarding every contract to counsel.
  • Experience working with an outside law firm or in-house counsel.
  • Comfort working in lower-tech setups (SharePoint, spreadsheets, Salesforce), not only e-signature platforms, and embracing new tools such as AI.

Preferred

  • Experience with public sector contracts and RFPs.
  • Experience with prime agreements and the terms that flow down from them, such as procurement codes and subcontracting commitments. Construction experience is a plus.
  • Experience with client security questionnaires.
  • Experience reviewing software, IT, and vendor agreements.
  • Experience with international contracts.

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
  • Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
  • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
  • Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado 

  • Competitive compensation 
  • Health insurance 
  • 401k with employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote work
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado 

Avicado, LLP was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more.

Avicado's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado, we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us!

raw.description:
At Tectu, you can make a real impact! As a DevOps Engineer you will play a lead role in delivering customer facing applications and backend infrastructure. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering cutting edge solutions to support the changing business needs and technology landscape. You will be working closely with others on our Product, UX and Engineering teams to define and deliver these solutions.

If you are passionate about technology, self-motivated and a disciplined freelancer, we would love to speak with you. The ideal candidate has both a willingness and desire to work in a dynamic environment, is able to apply Agile methodologies in day-to-day activities, and who enjoys working both independently with little oversight and in a team environment.

About the Role

At Tectu, we work with various customers, providing advanced tech solutions to solve different problems and needs. As a DevOps Engineer at Tectu, your day will most likely vary according to which projects youre involved in, but generally youll be performing the following activities:

  • Owning and building production-grade infrastructure from inception to deployment

  • Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with a variety of tools

  • Designing intuitive and well-documented infrastructure as code that allows our teams to get their jobs done efficiently, securely, and correctly.

  • Ensuring the performance and availability of our cloud infrastructure

  • Implementing and maintaining developer productivity tools

  • Developing the company's DevOps practice to enable smooth and frequent delivery

  • Contributing to team-wide efforts - code reviews, design reviews, technical decisions, and mentoring others

Requirements

  • 5+ years working with distributed infrastructure and microservices

  • Experience with the latest cloud technologies of one (preferably more) of the biggest vendors (AWS, Azure, Google)

  • Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform, Cloudformation, etc

  • Experience owning Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD)

  • Experience in setup, automating deployment, scaling and management of containerized applications with Kubernetes clusters

  • Experience in operating, monitoring and optimizing cloud infrastructure

  • Strong programming/scripting knowledge (e.g. Python, Bash, etc.)

  • Strong troubleshooting skills ability to use system monitoring, logs and other information to achieve root cause analysis and resolution

  • A proven track record of owning and delivering tasks and projects on time

Soft Skills

  • Strong work ethic and strong core values (honesty, integrity, creativity)

  • Sense of urgency, ownership mindset, and customer focus

  • Innovative problem solver who takes initiative never stops thinking about ways to improve

  • Ability to self-learn new skills and technologies

Advantage

  • BS in Computer Science, or similar degree is preferred

  • Able to create and communicate the 'big picture' in a clear way.

  • Attention to how existing processes can be made more efficient through automation

  • Understanding of security threats and how to build secure systems

  • Ability and willingness to create fantastic documentation for your peers and teammates

raw.title: Donor Relations Manager II, Latin America Region - The Nature Conservancy
raw.excerpt: Selection process developed by matteria Location and Work ModeRemote role based in Mexico, with domestic and international travel as required.
raw.description:
Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote role based in Mexico, with domestic and international travel as required.

Who we are

The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global environmental nonprofit dedicated to conserving the lands and waters on which all life depends. Founded in 1951, TNC combines science, collaboration, conservation, and innovative approaches to address some of the world's most complex environmental challenges. Its work brings together communities, governments, businesses, donors, scientists, and other partners to create lasting solutions for people and nature.

Our impact

Since its founding in 1951, The Nature Conservancy has grown to become one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Some key accomplishments include:

  • 86 countries and territories where TNC has conservation impact.

  • 1,000+ scientists contributing to TNC's conservation work.

  • 100+ marine conservation projects around the world.

  • 125M+ acres of land protected through TNC's work.

Purpose of the Position

The Donor Relations Manager II will strengthen the execution of TNC's fundraising strategy in Latin America by supporting the teams and Relationship Managers responsible for donor relationships connected to TNC's work in Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

The role enables fundraising opportunities through strong coordination, project management, donor strategy support, and collaboration across TNC's regional and global teams.

Key Responsibilities

Donor Strategy and Fundraising Support

  • Support the identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of international prospects and donors connected to TNC's work in Latin America.

  • Support donor strategies by understanding donor interests, capacity, potential, and alignment with TNC's conservation priorities across the region, with specific focus on Belize, Guatemala, and Mexico.

  • Support opportunities involving donors with the capacity to contribute more than USD 100,000.

Relationship Manager and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work closely with Relationship Managers, Business Units, Divisions, regional teams, and other internal stakeholders to advance international fundraising opportunities.

  • Serve as a bridge between international Relationship Managers and conservation teams, translating donor opportunities into the information, materials, expertise, and internal coordination required to move them forward.

  • Coordinate contributions from multiple stakeholders and ensure accountability for agreed deliverables.

Donor Engagement

  • Support donor meetings, donor trips, in-person events, leadership visits, and other engagement opportunities.

  • Help ensure donor experiences are well coordinated and aligned with TNC policies, standards, and expectations.

  • Support both international and local donor engagement opportunities connected to Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

Proposals, Stewardship and Communications

  • Collaborate with Donor Communications to develop donor materials, including proposals, stewardship notes, reports, and correspondence.

  • Help ensure donor communications are accurate, relevant, timely, and connected to the donor's interests and TNC's impact.

Internal Processes and Project Management

  • Project manage the internal review processes required for solicitations and gifts at local, regional, and global levels.

  • Coordinate complex and collaborative fundraising projects involving multiple development professionals and internal teams.

  • Manage timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and follow-up across multiple stakeholders.

Data, Reporting and Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate donor information in TNC's donor database.

  • Generate reports and analyze donor information to support fundraising decisions.

  • Track donor opportunities and use information to support cultivation, stewardship, and pipeline development.

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with TNC policies and procedures, as well as applicable donor, legal, and regulatory requirements.

  • Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive donor and organizational information.

  • Support consistent, high-quality donor engagement while minimizing organizational risk.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

  • Additional education, coursework, or training in fundraising, philanthropy, development, nonprofit management, business development, partnerships, or project management is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in fundraising, donor relations, development, philanthropy, business development, partnerships, or another relationship-oriented function.

  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with donors, partners, clients, volunteers, or other relevant stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders, teams, functions, or geographies.

  • Experience working in multicultural or cross-cultural environments.

  • Familiarity with Latin America and its cultural and professional context.

  • Based in Mexico.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Understanding of fundraising principles and donor engagement practices.

  • Strong project management and coordination capabilities.

  • Ability to organize multiple stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and processes simultaneously.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder interests and connect them with organizational priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to synthesize complex information and translate it into clear and actionable inputs.

  • Experience generating reports and analyzing and interpreting data.

  • Ability to work effectively across departments and multiple teams.

  • Experience with donor databases, CRM systems, reporting tools, or similar information-management platforms is desirable.

  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

Competencies

  • Relationship building: builds trust and productive relationships with diverse stakeholders, adapting communication to different levels of seniority, functions, cultures, and priorities.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: connects people and teams, understands different perspectives, and creates alignment around shared objectives without relying exclusively on formal authority.

  • Project management and execution: brings structure, accountability, and follow-through to complex processes involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • Strategic-operational thinking: understands the broader fundraising objective and translates it into practical actions, processes, materials, and next steps.

  • Autonomy and adaptability: navigates a complex, international, matrixed environment with initiative and sound judgment, moving work forward without constant supervision.

Our team profile

The ideal person enjoys connecting people, information, and opportunities. This is a team-oriented environment where success depends on working across functions and geographies, understanding different perspectives, and bringing people together around a shared objective. The team is looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys building meaningful professional relationships and networks.

  • Is genuinely interested in fundraising and philanthropy.

  • Is motivated by conservation and the possibility of contributing to TNC's mission.

  • Enjoys being the person who connects different teams and makes things happen.

  • Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and highly practical execution.

  • Is organized, rigorous, and dependable without becoming rigid.

  • Can operate effectively in a matrix where influence and collaboration are often more important than formal authority.

  • Is comfortable working with people from different countries, cultures, functions, and levels of seniority.

  • Takes ownership and can operate with autonomy.

  • Is willing to learn and make use of the professional development opportunities available within a global organization.

The role requires a bridge-builder mindset: someone who can understand what a Relationship Manager needs, what a conservation team can provide, and how to bring both sides together in a useful and timely way.

Key interests for working with us

  • Conservation and environmental protection.

  • Climate and biodiversity challenges.

  • The intersection between philanthropy and environmental impact.

  • Building relationships and networks around meaningful causes.

  • Understanding how different stakeholders can contribute to a common objective.

  • Working in a global organization where local realities and international resources need to be connected.

  • Contributing to conservation efforts in Latin America, particularly in Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

Reasons to join our team

  • The opportunity to contribute to the mission of one of the world's leading conservation organizations.

  • A regional role connecting fundraising and conservation work across Mexico, Belize, and Guatemala.

  • Exposure to an international, multicultural, and matrixed organization.

  • The opportunity to collaborate with Relationship Managers, development professionals, conservation teams, donor communications, and organizational leadership.

  • A role combining fundraising, relationship management, project management, and conservation.

  • Exposure to international fundraising opportunities and stakeholders.

  • Opportunities for professional development, learning, and networking within a global organization.

  • A comprehensive benefits package according to TNC policies, including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement-related benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance, and other employee benefits.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

  • Travel (often on short notice); long and flexible hours as needed.

  • Legal work authorization and residence in Mexico are required. Only Mexican nationals based in Mexico can be considered.

  • TNC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers accommodations in the application process for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Brief Overview of the Job Description:

We are seeking a seasoned DevOps Engineer to join our client, a distinguished IT services and consulting firm renowned for their comprehensive approach to solving modern business challenges. The role focuses on automating and optimizing operations and development processes. This position is critical for deploying product updates, identifying production issues, and implementing integrations to meet customer needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and related tools to reduce deployment costs and increase efficiency.
  • Implement cost-effective cloud solutions and optimize resource utilization across AWS, Azure, and GCP platforms.
  • Manage code deployments, fixes, updates, and related processes across multiple environments to ensure high availability and reliability for end-users.
  • Collaborate with customer-facing teams to understand user requirements and provide technical solutions that enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee automated testing to ensure system reliability, scalability, and security, reducing downtime and enhancing system performance.
  • Work closely with development teams to integrate new deployment processes and resolve configuration issues quickly and efficiently.
  • Utilize containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes to streamline development and production environments.
  • Implement robust monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and resolve production issues.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for CI/CD processes, deployment guidelines, and operational procedures.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to continually improve DevOps practices and processes.
  • Participate in training and certification programs to enhance skills and knowledge in cloud platforms and DevOps tools.
  • Mentor and train junior team members to build a strong DevOps culture within the organization.
  • Engage in continuous learning opportunities to stay ahead of technological advancements and best practices.

Technologies to be Used:

  • Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Terraform
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Python, Bash, Ansible

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Certifications in AWS, Azure, or GCP are highly desirable.
  • Certifications such as Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Jenkins, or Certified DevOps Professional are advantageous.

Knowledge:

  • Profound knowledge in cloud infrastructure, especially on platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Strong understanding of scripting and automation using tools such as Bash, Python, and Ansible.

Skills:

  • Expertise in using a wide range of cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure) including setting up, configuring, and optimizing.
  • Proficiency in CI/CD methodologies and tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Terraform).
  • Strong command over containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Solid scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with network protocols and standards, including HTTP, REST, SSL.

Attitude:

  • Problem-solving mindset with strong decision-making skills.
  • Highly proactive team player with an innovative approach to technology deployment.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Detail-oriented with a dedication to technical excellence and user satisfaction.
  • Enthusiastic about learning new technologies and tools.

Work Environment:

  • Dynamic and collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Supportive team culture that encourages knowledge sharing and professional growth.
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Efficiency and scalability of CI/CD pipelines.
  • System reliability and uptime.
  • Speed and quality of code deployments and updates.
  • Customer satisfaction with deployment processes and system performance.
  • Continuous improvement in automation and operational processes.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health insurance, dental and vision coverage.
  • Generous PTO and flexible work arrangements.
  • Access to ongoing training and career advancement opportunities.
  • Employee wellness and engagement programs.

Company Overview:

Mhymatch is hiring for a client who is a distinguished IT services and consulting firm renowned for their comprehensive approach to solving modern business challenges. Specializing in tailoring innovative IT solutions, this client leverages cutting-edge technology and deep industry expertise to empower businesses across various sectors. Their commitment to delivering exceptional strategic insights and operational excellence makes them a trusted advisor and partner in driving digital transformation and sustainable growth.

Diversity Policy:

Committed to a diverse work environment, we are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

Career Growth:

As a rapidly growing company, we offer substantial upward mobility and opportunities for career advancement. We support continuous learning with access to training and new technologies.

raw.description:
About Dr. Berg Nutritionals

Dr. Berg Nutritionals is a leader in the health and wellness industry focused on addressing the root causes of health concerns. We offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth, where you can contribute to helping millions achieve better health through education, premium supplements, and holistic practices like the Healthy Keto® diet.

Working with us, you'll be part of a globally recognized brand with a social media presence reaching over 49 million followers across platforms.

Be a part of an innovative and fast-growing company that is passionate about transforming lives through education on health and wellness. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where your contributions make a real impact, this is the place for you.

Role Summary

We’re looking for a YouTube Copywriter who can optimize our videos, making them easier to find, whether people search on Google, browse YouTube, or ask an AI assistant like ChatGPT or Gemini. In this role, you’ll research keywords, structure descriptions for discoverability, and write clear calls-to-action in a consistent brand voice, using AI to work faster while keeping your own judgment and creativity at the center. The successful candidate will have copywriting experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to give and receive direct feedback.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Rewrite and optimize YouTube video descriptions for Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
  • Conduct keyword research and naturally incorporate relevant search terms.
  • Structure descriptions to improve discoverability and support AI search engines and answer engines.
  • Include strategic calls-to-action copy with links where appropriate.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all content.
  • Leverage AI to increase productivity while also using critical thinking (not replacing it).
  • Keep multiple projects moving forward while maintaining the quality of communication in copywriting.
  • Leverage new technology to improve efficiency while keeping human creativity at the core.

Qualifications & Skills Required

  • Experience in YouTube description copywriting with demonstrated professional copywriting experience.
  • Demonstrated results growing organic traffic through experience with YouTube SEO or video content optimization.
  • Experience optimizing content for Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.
  • Knowledge of engagement mechanics, prompts, and calls to action that audiences can easily understand.
  • Ability to take strategy or business objectives and turn them into language people can quickly understand and engage with.
  • Strong judgment, including the ability to let go of a line that resonates with you but doesn’t translate well to the audience.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to strategically prioritize and meet strict deadlines.
  • Ability to research key words and metadata required to write accurate, engaging descriptions.
  • Comfortable working with large content libraries and repetitive workflows while maintaining quality.
  • Ability to receive direct feedback gracefully and to challenge a creative partner constructively.
  • Experience with health, nutrition, wellness, or educational content.

Note: Our application process requires a skills test.

Work from Home Requirements

  • Up-to-date Mac or Windows computer with anti-virus protection
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Quiet, distraction-free workspace
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools and software
  • Must be comfortable and experienced using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word, OneDrive)

Compensation & Benefits

We are intentional about creating a work environment that supports both high-quality work and the people doing it. We aim to provide our team with the structure, resources, and flexibility needed to do meaningful work while maintaining personal well-being.

We recognize that employees have responsibilities and priorities outside of work, and we respect and support that with our policies and benefits.

We are a fully remote team, allowing team members to work from where they are most comfortable and to avoid unnecessary commuting and overhead.

We offer competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to support health, stability, and balance, including:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with 80% of premiums covered by the company
  • 80 hours of paid vacation after one year of employment, with additional PTO that grows as you grow with us, (tenure-based increases)
  • 40 hours of personal days each year for rest, life, and everything in between
  • Paid gym membership to support your health and well-being
  • 7 paid holidays
  • 50% discount on all Dr. Berg products
  • Fully remote work with a strong emphasis on healthy work–life balance

Pay Range: $28 - $38 USD/hour DOE

Hours: Monday – Friday, 9am – 6pm ET, with one-hour unpaid meal break

Location: Fully remote

Type: Employee, full-time

Dr. Berg Nutritionals is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive workplace.

Note: We are not currently hiring international or California-based employees. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer (W-2) positions.

Salary: $28 – $38 / hour

raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Top Dog Law is one of the fastest-growing personal injury law firms in the country. Our decision science team turns data into decisions that move the business, not reports that sit in a folder. We're seeking a Senior Analyst to partner with our Client Marketing team and help us better understand, communicate with, and retain our clients.

The ideal candidate is a senior-level data analyst who is as comfortable writing complex SQL as they are explaining what the numbers mean to a marketing stakeholder. You will own the measurement behind how clients engage with Top Dog Law and use it to recommend what to change, what to scale, and what to stop.

What You Will Own

Client Marketing Analytics

  • Track and interpret client performance to understand adoption, engagement, and opportunities to improve the client experience
  • Report on and analyze metrics that drive client retention and engagement across the case lifecycle, including early indicators of disengagement and risk
  • Evaluate email and SMS performance to sharpen how, when, and what we communicate to clients
  • Measure and refine review generation strategies to grow the volume and quality of client reviews
  • Design and evaluate tests, and translate findings into clear recommendations for Client Marketing

Reporting & Decision Support

  • Write and maintain SQL that powers client marketing reporting and analysis
  • Build and maintain dashboards that surface actionable insights for Client Marketing
  • Prepare regular performance updates covering goals, results, and forward-looking recommendations
  • Gather and monitor NPS data
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to build workflows and accelerate analysis
  • Partner with data engineering and the broader decision science team to improve data quality and trust in the numbers

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data analyst role, with a track record of influencing business decisions
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, and window functions
  • Experience with web, email, SMS analytics and NPS
  • Experience analyzing CRM data (Salesforce)
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis and improve your work
  • Strong fundamentals in experimentation and statistics, including A/B testing and segmentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear story for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven problem-solver who proactively identifies issues, diagnoses root causes, and acts without waiting to be directed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Braze or a comparable customer engagement platform
  • Experience in client retention, customer lifecycle, or customer experience analytics
  • Experience with review generation or online reputation management
  • Experience in legal, insurance, or other service-based industries
  • Familiarity with modern BI and dashboarding tools

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $105,000 - $129,000, commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

DISCLAIMER: Each TopDog Law affiliated entity may use may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated decision-making tools to assist in screening and evaluating candidates for employment positions, including whether to advance a candidate in the application process. These tools assess job-related qualifications and characteristics—such as work experience, education, and skills relevant to the position as described in the job posting—based on information you provide in your application materials (e.g., resume, application responses, and other submitted materials, if any).

All adverse decisions affecting your candidacy are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team before being finalized. AI does not make the final decision on your candidacy.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Senior Business Intelligence Engineer

Fractl is partnering with a fast-growing, mission-driven company thats transforming health and human services with cutting-edge analytics tools.

They're looking for a Senior BI Engineer to design and deliver data products that turn complex healthcare data into clean, intuitive, and actionable insights.

In this role, you'll bridge technical implementation and user experience developing everything from data models and pipelines to dashboards that tell the full story. You'll collaborate across teams, own analysis workflows end-to-end, and help shape the future of data access within the public sector.

Location:100% Remote in the USA
Salary:$145k - $165k
Tech Stack: SQL and Python
Visa Status: US Citizen or Green Card Holder

Who Are You?

  • ﻿A data storyteller who brings clarity to chaos through clean models and smart visualizations.
  • Fluent in SQL and comfortable shaping large, messy healthcare data into trusted sources of truth.
  • A builder at heart, you love developing scalable tools that make it easier for people to access insights.
  • You've worked closely with product managers, analysts, or end users to understand the why behind the work.

What Will You Do?

  • Design and build scalable, self-service data products that turn messy healthcare data into actionable insight.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to understand user needs and create solutions that meet them.
  • Build and maintain robust analysis pipelines and high-quality visualizations.
  • Optimize SQL workflows for performance and scalability.
  • Conduct advanced analysis, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data integrity across platforms.
  • Recommend product improvements based on insights from existing data.

Why Join?

  • Work at a mission-driven company thats redefining how data can improve public health outcomes.
  • Fully remote flexibility with a collaborative, forward-thinking team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits, including subsidized healthcare, 401(k) match, generous PTO, and company-paid holidays.
  • Opportunity to make a visible, lasting impact from day one.

Apply to the role to learn more!

Fractl Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and recruitment agency. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We work to ensure a fair and inclusive hiring process.﻿

Job Summary
We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Architect with expertise in AWS, Generative AI, AI/ML, and scalable production-level architectures. The ideal candidate should have experience handling multiple clients, leading technical teams, and designing end-to-end cloud-based AI solutions with an overallexperience of 9-12 years.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance architectures on AWS for AI/ML applications.

AI/ML & Generative AI Expertise

Cloud & Infrastructure Management
Architect event-driven, serverless, and microservices architectures for AI/ML applications.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization in cloud deployments.
Implement IAM, VPC, security best practices, and compliance.
Team & Client Engagement
Lead and mentor a team of ML engineers, Python Developer and Cloud Engineers.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and multiple clients to define requirements and deliver AI/ML/GenAI-driven solutions.
Conduct technical workshops, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Multi-Client & Business Strategy
Manage multiple client engagements, delivering AI/ML/GenAI solutions tailored to their business needs.
Define AI/ML/GenAI roadmaps, proof-of-concept strategies, and go-to-market AI solutions.
Stay updated on cutting-edge AI advancements and drive innovation in AI/ML offerings.

Requirements

Key Skills & Technologies
Cloud & DevOps
AWS Services: Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, Fargate, OpenSearch, RDS
MLOps: SageMaker Pipelines, CI/CD (CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CDK)
Security: IAM, VPC, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, KMS, Cognito
AI/ML & GenAI
LLMs & Generative AI: Bedrock (Claude, Mistral, Titan), OpenAI, Llama
ML Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, Hugging Face
Vector DBs: OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS
RAG Pipelines, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning
Software Architecture & Scalability
Serverless & Microservices Architecture
API Design & GraphQL
Event-Driven Systems (SNS, SQS, EventBridge, Step Functions)
Performance Optimization & Auto Scaling

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 22-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT TEAM YOU’LL BE PART OF

You'll join the Creative team, a team of designers and developers led Philippe, Creative Director,, with members based in Paris, San Francisco, and Seoul.

In short, the Creative team is responsible for producing all the ad creatives that power Adikteev's campaigns. This means designing and developing every format Adikteev uses: statics, videos, MRAIDs (interactive HTML5 banners), playable ads, and native ads. The team works hand-in-hand with Account Management and clients to translate campaign briefs into high-performing creatives, from initial concept and client workshops all the way through to final delivery and performance iteration.

The team also plays a strategic role: tracking design trends, building best practices from top-performing creatives, and creating templates that improve the overall production workflow.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As Creative Lead for APAC, you’ll help build and scale one of Adikteev’s highest-potential regions. Concretely, this means:

Creative Strategy & Production:

  • Prioritise and drive creative production for our clients’ app, being responsible for the quality of delivery.

  • Brainstorm and generate new ideas for mobile creatives.

  • Design animated, interactive, and playable mobile ads that allow a consistent brand experience, such as videos, storyboards, and motion graphics that support and enhance advertising campaigns.

Creative Performance & Client Strategy:

  • Analyse ad performance data and iterate on creatives to improve performance.

  • Participate in client meetings, providing feedback and insights on creatives.

  • Watch the market and be constantly looking to try new things and concepts.

  • Develop and maintain a high standard of creative guidelines, processes, benchmarks, and best practices.

Team Leadership:

  • Manage the design team in APAC, guiding them from idea generation through creative production, while helping them improve the performance of their ads (messaging, etc.) and their client presentations.

WHO YOU ARE

You’ll thrive in this role, and be a great fit for the Creative team at Adikteev, if you bring:

Experience & background:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Creative Designer or in a similar role.

  • Previous experience managing a team.

  • Background in ad tech or a mobile gaming studio.

Skills:

  • Proficiency with After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (Adobe Creative Cloud).

  • Knowledge of interaction design.

  • Understanding of the building blocks of game development, including animation, AI, graphics engines, and related systems.

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS is a plus.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Creative mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.

  • Strong team spirit.

  • Organized and methodical, with the ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining rigor and responsiveness.

  • Autonomous, accountable, and able to take ownership of your work.

Languages:

  • English: full professional proficiency - mandatory;

  • Chinese (Mandarin): full professional proficiency - mandatory

Please note that, for legal reasons, candidates are required to hold Korean or Chinese citizenship and/or maintain residency in China / South Korea in order to be considered for this position.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs ;

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years ;

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Friday afternoons off) ;

  • 1.7 paid leave per month from the 1st month ;

  • Festive holiday season support for Chuseok & Seollal ;

  • Flexible remote working policy ;

  • Mental Health support ;

  • Medical check-up support.

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • Call with Maxime, Talent Acquisition Lead;

  • Team fit interview with Christel, EMEA Creative Team Lead, & Miso, Creative Designer;

  • Use case to complete remotely and present to Philippe, Creative Director, and John, Country Manager;

  • Final interview with Clément, Global COO and Antoine, CCO.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.
