Watton Hall are working with a leading pharmaceutical company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative therapies and solutions. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of compliance and legal integrity in all our operations.

﻿As an In-House Counsel, you will provide comprehensive legal support to our pharmaceutical operations, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations while facilitating business objectives. You will work closely with various departments, including R&D, regulatory affairs, marketing, and sales, to navigate complex legal issues in the pharmaceutical industry.

﻿Location: Europe

﻿Main Responsibilities

  • ﻿Provide legal advice on a wide range of pharmaceutical matters, including drug development, clinical trials, regulatory compliance, intellectual property rights, and commercial transactions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts related to research agreements, licensing agreements, vendor contracts, and other commercial arrangements.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA regulations and other relevant laws governing the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop strategies that align legal considerations with business goals.
  • Monitor changes in legislation and regulations affecting the pharmaceutical sector and advise management on potential impacts.
  • Conduct training sessions for employees on compliance issues related to pharmaceutical laws and regulations.
  • Manage relationships with external counsel as needed for specialized legal matters.
  • Support the company's efforts in protecting its intellectual property portfolio through patent applications and litigation strategies.

Profile

  • ﻿Law Degree from an accredited law school
  • 5+ years of experience as a practicing attorney in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
  • Experience working in-house at a pharmaceutical company or within a law firm specializing in healthcare law is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA regulations and compliance requirements for pharmaceuticals.

Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.

title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
description: KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

raw.title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
raw.excerpt: KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
raw.description:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates.

The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred.

We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000.

What you will do

Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice

  • Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
  • Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.
  • Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
  • Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.
  • Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.

Own the methodology and its defensibility

  • Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.
  • Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
  • Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.
  • Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.
  • Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.

Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory

  • Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
  • Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
  • Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
  • Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.

Partner with Product and Engineering

  • Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
  • Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
  • Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.

Lead clients and cross-functional partners

  • Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
  • Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
  • Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.

What you bring

Required:

  • 10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
  • A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.
  • Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
  • Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
  • Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
  • A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
  • A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
  • Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.

Preferred:

  • Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
  • Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
  • Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
  • Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.

Our mission and core values:

We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.

Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

As part of the job

Position: B2B Sales Executive

Salary: up to £1,100 per month

Working Hours: UK business hours

Holidays: UK public holidays

About the Role:

We are seeking an articulate, commercially sharp B2B Sales Executive to join an innovative UK publishing and business engagement company as a dedicated, full-time remote team member.

The business operates a unique digital platform and publishing service that helps entrepreneurs and corporate leaders capture personal insights, engage their audiences, generate warm leads, and publish co-authored books.

This is a full-cycle sales role reporting directly to the Founder. You will take ownership of outbound business development—converting incoming interest and driving proactive outreach into closed deals. Speaking directly with UK business owners, CEOs, and senior decision-makers, you will simplify a unique product proposition and guide prospects from initial contact through to closing.

Key Responsibilities

Product Proposition & Full-Cycle Closing

  • Selling a Unique Concept: Simplify and articulate an unfamiliar, consultative product proposition naturally—uncovering buyer motivations (personal branding, prestige, lead generation) and demonstrating clear commercial value.
  • Dual Market Targeting:
    • Individual Package (£995): Target entrepreneurs and business owners seeking personal recognition, profile raising, and authority (initial focus).
    • Corporate Package (£25,000): Target CEOs and senior executives at established businesses (£5m+ turnover) seeking customer engagement and lead generation.
  • Full Sales Cycle Ownership: Manage conversations end-to-end—moving leads from outreach through discovery, presentation, objection handling, and deal closing independently.

Outreach & Pipeline Management

  • Unscripted Outreach: Engage UK decision-makers via phone, email, and LinkedIn using personality, wit, and intelligent conversation rather than rigid scripts.
  • Pipeline Execution: Independently manage follow-ups, keep accurate CRM records, and drive consistent conversions without requiring day-to-day oversight.
  • Brand Protection: Represent a well-established brand with high emotional intelligence, credibility, and professionalism.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven Closing Track Record: Demonstrated experience in B2B outbound sales, with direct personal responsibility for closing deals and generating revenue (not just booking appointments).
  • Concept & Consultative Selling: Proven ability to sell complex, abstract, or non-standard products/services (SaaS, marketing, publishing, or consultative solutions) that require educating the buyer.
  • UK Executive Presence: Exceptional spoken and written English, a natural conversational style, and the confidence to engage UK CEOs and business owners credibly.
  • Commercial Drive: Self-motivated, resilient, and highly organised, with the ability to manage a pipeline autonomously from day one.

What Success Looks Like

Prospects are educated and converted into paying clients efficiently, the founder is freed from day-to-day sales execution, a healthy pipeline is maintained independently, and deals are closed consistently.

Candidate Assessment & Vetting Focus

To candidate screening will specifically evaluate:

  1. Closing vs. Booking: Actual deals personally closed and revenue generated (rather than vanity metrics or meeting counts).
  2. Concept Simplification: Ability to explain a non-standard or complex product in simple, value-driven terms during interview scenarios.
  3. Communication & Wit: Natural, unscripted verbal communication, tone, confidence, and emotional intelligence when speaking with senior leaders.
  4. Brand Trust & Autonomy: Evidence of independent pipeline management and high professional standards that warrant complete trust with Trevor's brand.

Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Top Dog Law is one of the fastest-growing personal injury law firms in the country. Our decision science team turns data into decisions that move the business, not reports that sit in a folder. We're seeking a Senior Analyst to help us decide where to invest, where to scale, and where to grow next.

The ideal candidate is a senior-level data analyst who thinks in markets: someone who can combine data from many sources into a clear view of where the opportunity is, and who is as comfortable writing complex SQL as they are presenting a recommendation to marketing and firm leadership. You will shape how Top Dog Law evaluates its existing markets and chooses new ones.

What You Will Own

Market Analysis

  • Evaluate marketing ROI at the market level to show where our investment is working hardest and where it is not
  • Pinpoint markets that are ready to scale, and build the case for how much and how fast
  • Analyze marketing channel data across our media mix including; Meta, YouTube, CTV, Radio, and others.
  • Follow the conversion funnel across markets and uncover what is driving the differences in performance
  • Assess market saturation and bring together multiple data sources to size the opportunity in each market
  • Conduct competitive analysis to understand how we stack up and where competitors are leaving room
  • Identify and prioritize new markets for expansion

Reporting & Decision Support

  • Write and maintain SQL that powers market-level reporting and analysis
  • Build and maintain dashboards that give marketing and leadership a clear view of market performance
  • Prepare regular updates covering results, market opportunity, and forward-looking recommendations
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to build workflows and accelerate analysis
  • Partner with data engineering and the broader decision science team to improve data quality and trust in the numbers

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data analyst role, with a track record of influencing business decisions
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, and window functions
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance and ROI, ideally across geographies or markets
  • Experience building and interpreting conversion funnels and diagnosing what drives performance
  • Comfort combining and reconciling multiple internal and external data sources into a single view
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis and improve your work
  • Strong fundamentals in statistics and analytical problem solving, including knowing when a result is signal versus noise
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear story for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven problem-solver who proactively identifies issues, diagnoses root causes, and acts without waiting to be directed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with market sizing, saturation modeling, or market expansion analysis
  • Experience with competitive intelligence or market research data
  • Experience working with geographic or location-based data
  • Experience in legal, insurance, or other lead-driven, service-based industries
  • Familiarity with modern BI and dashboarding tools

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

auxi is seeking a Sr. Designer based in India who thrives in fast-paced startup environments and to support the execution of high-quality creative across marketing, sales enablement, events, and digital channels. You will work directly with the VP of Marketing and VP of Ops to shape creative direction, own projects end-to-end, and produce world-class design across every touchpoint of our brand and product.

This is not a role for someone who waits for direction. You will be the creative engine behind a growing SaaS company, raising the bar, shipping work you are proud of, and helping build a design culture that scales.

What You'll Do

  • Design and deliver high-quality marketing and sales assets

  • Collaborate with the ops and customer success teams to develop client-facing deliverables like PowerPoint decks, and QBRs
  • Translate complex product concepts into clear, compelling visuals that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Produce and edit demo videos that showcase product features in a clear, engaging, and visually compelling way
  • Handle end-to-end video editing for marketing and sales content, including cuts, transitions, text overlays, sound design, and final export across formats and platforms

Execution & Delivery

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing effectively and consistently hitting deadlines without sacrificing quality
  • Take ownership of work from concept through final delivery with minimal oversight
  • Thrive in ambiguity and turn a rough brief, a Teams message, or a whiteboard sketch into something great

What We're Looking For

Nice to Have

Why Join Us

raw.description:
Overview

NASCO is looking for a skilled Sr. Product Owner to join the Product Management team to partner across multiple product portfolios, driving the discovery and delivery of AI-enabled solutions that accelerate modernization, improve business outcomes, and create customer value.

The Product Owner assists the Product Manager in conveying a clear product vision to the Product Delivery team with an emphasis on effective communication and collaboration. The Product Owner is primarily responsible for managing a well maintained, groomed and effective product backlog through the creation of user stories that support the product and organizational objectives.

This role executes on the Product Roadmap by infusing the 'voice of the customer' in user stories and other requirements. This role is the liaison between the Product Delivery team and the Product Strategists and business leaders. The Product Owner has a strong business acumen and technical understanding to ensure the business need is achieved through development efforts. Communicates with manager on projects, goals and initiatives.

Responsibilities

Release Planning: Creates and drives an execution plan for the Product Roadmap

  • Translates the Product Strategist’s (Manager’s) roadmap (epics) into clearly defined feature sets & requirements, establishing goals and priorities per release
  • Works with the Product Strategist to maintain the Product Roadmap and help determine the sequence features should be developed and released to customers
  • Prioritizes backlog and product requests from multiple sources to deliver the most value to the organization

Voice of the Customer: Represents the ‘Voice of the Customer’ internally, serving as internal subject matter expert for development team:

  • Communicates with current and potential customers on a regular basis to understand their processes and needs as they change over time, transposing those into requirements
  • Leads customer advisors in product governance sub-committees
  • Develops and maintains user personas

Requirement Creation & Management: Leads feature design, user interaction, requirement definitions, acceptance criteria, and prioritization to internal Development, QA, Architecture, and Security teams:

  • Produces user personas, user stories, work-flows, prototypes, designs, data maps, and/or process maps to document the functionality and operation of all features, enhancements and new offerings for development teams
  • Works with engineering to identify non-functional requirements and enabler stories; sequencing them appropriately into releases
  • Works with QA team member(s) to identify test cases for automated testing

Release Lifecycle: Delivers and manages new feature development for successful releases:

  • Maintains, manages, and prioritizes a well-groomed product backlog to support multiple Product Delivery teams to include Enabler Stories (Architecture, Exploration, Infrastructure), User Stories (Feature / Function), and Improvement Stories (Bugs, Defects, enhancements)
  • Participates in agile and development ceremonies, assisting Scrum Master or Project Manager in Sprint reviews.
  • Communicates both what is to be developed and why to Product Delivery teams; answering questions to clarify requirement and acceptance criteria
  • Works with business customers and NASCO’s User Acceptance Testing team to conduct testing prior to and during development to ensure product functionality is aligned to user needs and will delight customers
  • Demonstrates latest iteration to customers (pre-release) and gathers feedback.
  • Manages entire release lifecycle from Sprint 0 to launch; inspecting progress of every sprint, accept or reject work, and explain why

Launch Readiness: Determines if product is ready to release, ensuring scope & quality of the release:

  • Develops and implements GA and readiness plans
  • Provides technical details and works closely with technical writers, training and marketing to develop market facing content and product documentation that reflect product enhancements and new feature benefits
  • Supports go-to-market enablement activities such as go-live training

Budget & P&L: Ensure the financial viability of the product by:

  • Manages scope and development forecasts to approved budget
  • Captures, tracks and manages identified budget issues
  • Ensures product feature implementation stays within acceptable cost of goods sold

Cross-Functional Responsibilities: Fosters and manages key stakeholder relationships:

  • Communicates project status to key stakeholders; identifies and escalates risks in scope, cost, and timing
  • Translates business strategy to internal teams
  • Manages vendor / partner technical relationships

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Training:

  • Ability to use AI appropriately in the day-to-day work
  • Must have a proactive work ethic, desire to challenge the status quo, and an attitude that focuses on the voice of the customer
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills required, including representing NASCO externally to our clients and the market
  • Ability to conceptualize, negotiate and work with peers, Product Delivery teams and management
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
  • Demonstrated success defining and launching excellent products

Required Experience:

  • 10 years of experience as product owner, in product management or related functions
  • 5+ years Business Analysts experience crafting detailed product requirements
  • 10 or more years claims processing experience

Required Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information technology, healthcare, or equivalent professional experience required

Desired Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Experience:

  • Technical background with expertise and experience in SAFe/Agile/Waterfall development methods
  • Experience in iterative and user-centric design practices to identify and collaborate on the best customer experience with the products
  • Experience with design thinking practices to identify and collaborate on pain points and opportunities in the marketplace
  • 3 years’ experience working in healthcare IT

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

Physical and Mental Health Benefits

  • Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits
  • Generous PTO with buy/sell options
  • 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness program - earn insurance discounts or credit towards health-related items

Financial Health Benefits

  • 401K Plan with employer matching contributions
  • Company-funded spending/reimbursement accounts to help with out-of-pocket medical expenses
  • Bonus and Recognition programs
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

  • E-Learning – Comprehensive and current library of e-learning and performance support assets, available on demand and at no cost

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other grounds, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability. Must have legal authority to work in the US.

We will not accept applicants that use AI when answering the screening questions. Applicants who use AI to answer any questions or to complete their application will not be considered for employment.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.

WHAT TEAM YOU WILL BE PART OF

You will be joining the Machine Learning team. They have full ownership of Adikteev's ML ecosystem; building and maintaining the systems that power the core of our business at massive scale. They operate with a strong product ownership mindset, working at the intersection of research and production, where the models they ship have a direct and measurable impact on billions of real-time decisions every day.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Technical Leadership: Set technical direction,

  • Model Development: Design and train on predictive models for CTR, CR, VTA, bid shading, and auction-win probability across display and video inventory,

  • Platform Engineering: Scale our ML platform — feature stores, training pipelines, model versioning, A/B experimentation — to support multiple model families running in production simultaneously,

  • Real-time Systems: Drive sub-10ms inference at high QPS through model optimization (ONNX), efficient serving, and latency-aware architecture decisions,

  • MLOps & Observability: Own end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion through monitoring: drift detection, shadow scoring, A/B tests, and automated retraining triggers ; drive design reviews, ADRs, and mentoring of senior+ ML engineers. Translate business objectives into technical strategies,

  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with Tech Reporting and Analytics to define ML KPIs, instrument experiments, and communicate model performance to stakeholders up to Comex level,

  • Applied Research: Design and set up a neural network for adtech from the ground up, taking it from prototype to production in our bidding stack.

★ WHO YOU ARE

You could be a great addition to our Engineering team if you have:

  • 8+ years of industry ML engineering experience, with 3+ years building and owning production ML systems at scale.

  • Hands-on adtech experience is required — programmatic advertising (RTB/DSP), mobile attribution (MMP ecosystem, SKAdNetwork, Privacy Sandbox), or real-time bidding — alongside deep expertise in recommender systems and/or LTV/churn modeling.

  • Strong command of the modern ML stack: Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow or Weights & Biases, Spark or Flink for feature engineering.

  • Experience with real-time serving infrastructure: Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve, or custom low-latency gRPC services.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals — you write production-grade, reviewable code and care about system reliability.

  • Track record of delivering value incrementally — shipping working software in small, frequent increments rather than large multi-quarter projects.

  • Clear, concise communicator who can translate model performance into business impact for non-technical audiences.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in France or the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

Competitive Salary between 130,000€ and 150,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

★ PERKS AND BENEFITS*

  • Competitive Salary ;

  • Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs;

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years ;

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off) ;

  • “RTT” ;

  • Mental Health support ;

  • Flexible remote working policy ;

  • Regular team-life event / activity ;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are.


★ OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR interview with Claire, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

  • Technical test to complete remotely

  • Technical interview with Gwennaëlle, Staff ML Engineer and Pedro, Senior ML Engineer,

  • Manager interview with Cédric, CTO,

  • Comex interview.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

★ OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

  • Ensuring high performance and scalability of systems and infrastructure.

  • Building reusable components for backend infrastructure

Overview

Join Reynolds Consumer Products…and Drive Your Career across a world of opportunities!

We currently have an opportunity for a Category Manager to join our Sales team. This is a remote position.

Responsibilities

The Category Manager drives category growth and customer business performance through fact-based insights, category management strategies, and cross-functional collaboration. The position partners with internal sales teams and external retail customers to develop category recommendations, optimize assortment and shelf space, and strengthen selling initiatives across omnichannel retail environments. The role translates category performance, shopper behavior, competitive activity, and market trends into actionable recommendations that support customer objectives and business growth. Through analytical expertise, customer partnership, and sales team development, the Category Manager influences category strategy and retail execution while operating independently across multiple priorities and customer relationships.

You Will Have the Opportunity to Make Great Things Happen!

Category Strategy and Business Partnership

  • Advance category management initiatives by collaborating with internal and external partners to align strategic and tactical selling plans across multiple organizational levels.
  • Serve as the category and competitive subject matter expert for internal headquarters business groups, providing fact-based selling support to sales management.
  • Establish strong working relationships with retailer category managers by providing objective, category-focused analytical support.
  • Apply shopper insights to category and brand sales presentations, providing thought leadership and a vision for overall category growth.

Analytics and Insights

  • Prepare and present fact-based category insights for multiple retail partners across omnichannel markets.
  • Analyze category performance, shopper insights, category fundamentals, and macroeconomic trends using point-of-sale, syndicated, custom, panel, loyalty, and retailer data.
  • Monitor category performance through weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting tailored to retailer category management and internal customer needs, addressing additional business questions ae required.

Assortment Optimization and Sales Enablement

  • Partner with retailer category managers to develop optimal assortments and planograms through space management capabilities.
  • Coach and train sales partners at all levels on category management, consumer dynamics, syndicated data, market structure, shopper insights, opportunity gaps, competitive landscapes, and shelf-space optimization.

You Will Love It Here If…

  • You listen, learn, and evolve
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • You put safety first, always
  • You are passionate about collaboration, teamwork, and achieving shared goals
  • You believe in treating all people with respect, operating ethically, and growing a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
  • You are committed to improving our impact on local communities and creating positive experiences

Qualifications

Education/Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience to successfully perform the essential functions of the position.
  • 6+ years of experience in category management, category development, or shopper insights within the broader consumer packaged goods industry.
  • Ability to travel overnight periodically, as needed, approximately 20–30% of the time.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Business Administration or another advanced degree.
  • Experience supporting Dollar General, Kroger, Albertsons, or other key grocery customers.
  • Experience supporting grocery channel customers.
  • Experience analyzing complex datasets and developing actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience building strong relationships with customers and retail partners.
  • Experience with category management processes, data analysis, and shopper insights.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and storytelling capabilities, including the ability to gather, compile, and analyze data and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Knowledge of category management principles, consumer and shopper insights, syndicated data, retailer data, and space management practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage projects from initiation through execution.
  • Self-directed approach with the ability to manage multiple accountabilities and internal customer relationships.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and customer requests while maintaining business deadlines.
  • Team-oriented approach with the ability to collaborate across functions and customer organizations.

About InvestEngine

We’re a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we’re just getting started. We’ve been featured by Forbes, MoneyWeek, and Finder, and we’re growing fast with big ambitions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Middle QA Engineer to join our high-velocityGrowthteam — own quality across the whole customer journey, from landing page and registration through onboarding to analytics, at a high task flow.You’ll work with strict protocols, regulations, and third-party providers to make sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, product managers, marketers, and external partners, often in English. In this role, you’ll take real ownership of building high-quality, resilient features — perfect for someone proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to grow in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Manually test frontend and backend features

  • Collaborate with developers and marketers to clarify requirements

  • Proactively identify gaps, propose improvements, and help evolve QA processes

  • Perform basic API testing using Postman

  • Write and run simple SQL queries to validate data

  • Use proxy tools for deeper request/response validation

  • Support regression testing in mobile apps when needed

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of manual QA experience, focused on web applications

  • Solid knowledge of test design techniques

  • Hands-on experience testing APIs and working with Postman

  • Technical literacy: HTML/CSS, client-server architecture, and basic debugging

  • Ability to write SQL queries to validate backend logic

  • Confident using proxy tools like Charles or Fiddler

  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills — not just following test scripts

  • Self-driven, organized, and comfortable working without micromanagement

  • Clear communicator who collaborates well with tech and non-tech teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing mobile apps (Android/iOS)

  • Interest in building or improving QA workflows and processes

  • Familiarity with automation tools or AI-assisted testing (not required, but a plus)

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement. You’ll be more than just a ticket-tester — you’ll help shape how we build, ship, and maintain quality across the product.

We expect initiative, not just execution. At the same time, you’ll have support from experienced QA leads and an open, collaborative culture that encourages experimentation and learning.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one
    You’ll help ship critical features used by tens of thousands of customers.

  • Room to grow
    You’ll have the chance to expand your scope — from owning areas of testing to helping shape team-wide QA practices.

  • Modern tools
    You’ll work with Postman, SQL, and more. And if something’s missing — help us find and adopt it.

  • Transparent and open culture
    We believe in async-first communication, clear ownership, and team visibility.

  • Supportive team
    You’ll collaborate with thoughtful, motivated people across engineering, product, and marketing.

  • Remote and flexible
    We care about outcomes, not location. Work from where you’re most productive.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Technical interview with the QA Team

  3. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  4. Final conversation with our QA Lead

AI/ML

Data science

Business intelligence

Data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Job description:

Key Purpose of the Job:

Reporting to the Head of Technical Services Director, this position provides administrative and technical fire safety support to a large team of fire risk assessors across the UK.

Working with an established Fire Safety team, the primary responsibility will be to undertake technical auditing of Fire risk assessment reports that have been completed and submitted by our onsite assessors. Providing feedback to and mentoring fire risk assessors.

Typically, fire risk assessments vary in complexity and will range between small shop and office type businesses, up to and including large multiuse, high-rise buildings that may include engineered solutions to achieve compliance with current regulation.

Independent judgment is required to plan, prioritise, and organise a diversified workload. The most qualified candidate for this role will have experience providing technical fire safety advice and support to fire safety teams, individuals or clients previously.

This role would suit an experienced fire risk safety professional nearing the end of their career or looking to reduce time spent away from home with the role being hybrid.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Auditing reports to ensure technical compliance with the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice to on-site assessors and operations team members as required.
  • Ensure adherence to BAFE 205 standards for validation of fire risk assessments to ensure consistency of reporting.
  • Achieve expected key performance indicators to meet client expectations.
  • Manage the volume of audit work
  • Undertake desktop reviews on a wide variety of premise types. To include fire risk assessment desk top reviews, review of fire strategy plans, fire door plans, compartmentation drawings, and other relevant fire safety plans and drawings.
  • Undertake peer review/validation of others work.
  • Actively coach and mentor fire risk assessors to drive continuous improvement in service delivery. Conduct on-site visits such as ad-hoc requests and quarterly or annual audits of fire risk assessors.
  • To deal with client enquiries/questions regarding completed fire risk assessments

Requirements

Essential Requirements:

  • Level 4 in Fire Risk Assessment or higher
  • Evidence of several years’ experience undertaking practical fire risk assessment activities including the preparation of reports.
  • Entry on the BAFE SP205 validator registry or prepared to be assessed for entry to the register.
  • To maintain competence and to remain on the BAFE SP205 register.
  • To carry out onsite Fire risk assessments as required to maintain competence.
  • To have used and demonstrate a good knowledge of a wide range of fire safety guidance documents and have an understanding of Building Regulation Fire Safety Approved Document B Volume 1&2
  • Able to work independently as well as in a collaborative environment.
  • Great Communication skills – written and verbal.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in all areas of work.
  • A full driving licence

Desirable Requirements for the Job:

  • Local fire authority – technical fire safety enforcement experience
  • Fire Engineering qualification Level 4
  • Problem assessment and resolution

  • Full Support from Leadership Team
  • Life Insurance
  • Company Health Care Plan
  • 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
  • Immediate start available
  • Career development opportunities
  • Referral Scheme
  • Employee Benefits Programme including shopping vouchers and discount; up to £1,200 a year on real savings for everyday needs.
  • Wagestream – Get instant access to your wages through our financial wellbeing tool.

Job Title: Salesforce Consultant

Job Code: IT1942

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Manager

FLSA Status: Exempt

Supervisory: No supervisory/management authority

Prepared Date: 10/19/2026

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen. Public Trust Eligible.

Position Summary:

Seeking a Salesforce Consultant to support a federal financial regulatory environment. This role partners with government product, and program leads to modernize and optimize Salesforce capabilities, including Salesforce Classic to Lightning migration, requirements leadership, and delivery support across configuration, testing, and deployment.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Salesforce Consultant: $130,000 – $140,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Lead projects from prioritization through concept development and user story writing to supporting development, testing, and deployment.
  • Work with government leads to manage scope of new project enhancement requests; clarify objectives, constraints, acceptance criteria, and release timing.
  • Work with Product Owner and users to determine operational objectives of business needs and elicit requirements.
  • Identify core business needs and decompose and document them in concepts of operation, story maps, briefings, and user stories; document business rules and construct workflow diagrams as needed.
  • Translate complex business processes into clear and actionable user stories with thorough acceptance criteria, including exception paths and operational reporting needs.
  • Support Salesforce Classic to Lightning migration activities, including discovery, gap analysis, Lightning experience redesign, readiness planning, and post-cutover stabilization.
  • Configure and optimize Salesforce using declarative tools, with emphasis on Flow (record-triggered, screen flows, scheduled flows), approvals, validation rules, page layouts, and Lightning App Builder to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
  • Ensure declarative automation is scalable, maintainable, and aligned with governance, auditability, and compliance expectations in a regulated environment.
  • Present formal and informal oral and written briefings to government managers; produce executive-ready summaries and decision support materials.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience leading requirements in an Agile delivery environment, including story mapping, user story writing, and acceptance criteria development.
  • Experience documenting business rules and processes using workflow diagrams and structured artifacts (e.g., CONOPS).
  • Hands-on experience with declarative configuration and automation, including Salesforce Flow.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to brief senior government stakeholders.

•U.S. Citizenship is required.

  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

•Must be a US Citizen.

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with preferred study in Computer Science, Information Science, Information Systems Management, Math, Statistics, Operations Research, or Engineering and a minimum of eight (8) years of experience.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. HESFP, LLC, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal #Remote

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is $130,000 – $140,000. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Cherokee Federal is a federal contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA). As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Cherokee Federal takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at .

This position is subject to pre-employment drug testing. Cherokee Federal maintains a drug-free workplace in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and regulations.

This position may be contingent upon the successful completion of a background investigation. The scope of the investigation will be commensurate with position requirements and applicable law.

This position is pending a contract award. If you are interested in a future with Cherokee Federal, please APPLY TODAY! Although this is not yet an approved position, we are accepting applications for this future and anticipated need. The applicable salary range will be posted promptly upon award of the contract and once funding for the position has been determined. No offer will be extended prior to posting the applicable salary range.

As an experienced online educator, the candidate will work as an independent contractor of LINC Education to offer online facilitation services for students studying in theMasters of Nursing (Online) offered by Victoria University Online. Candidate must possess strong knowledge of ageing and chronic disease management, with the ability to deliver evidence-based, person-centred nursing care.   • Full rights to work within Australia.

  • An Australian Business Number or ABN as a sole trader, or of the entity that will contract with LINC.

  • Empathetic, ambitious, warm and outgoing personality willing to work closely with people from diverse cultures;

  • Proficient in English language; excellent oral and written communication

  • Must possess a working laptop and have access to high-speed (>10 MBPS) stable internet connection;

  • Ability to quickly learn and use technology platforms for interacting with students, including the host university’s LMS and LINCtrac (training on these platforms will be provided).

The candidate needs to be available between 5 pm to 10 pm every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

LINC Fellows will be responsible for providing:

  1. Subject matter guidance to a group of 25-30 undergraduate online students;

  2. Support in learning skills like academic writing, research and time management;

  3. 1:1 and small group tutoring sessions;

  4. Guidance on relevant reference material;

  5. Assessment marking with long-form feedback

  6. Management of discussion forums; and

  7. Proactive, prompt and personalised support to student queries and issues.

LINC Fellows will be expected to promptly interact with students over email, or calls / online sessions from locations of their convenience (e.g. home, office etc.).

About LINC Education

LINC Education (), based in Singapore, with teams in Australia, India, the UK and the US, is a global pioneer in providing high-touch, high-quality educator-led online teaching services to globally ranked universities around the world. Our specialist services are highly sought after by university managements and faculty to retain and grow their online student enrolments. LINC’s services are customised for each university and delivered using a cutting-edge technology platform (LINCtrac) to provide a superior and effective learning experience to students. Since 2017, we have delivered online degrees on behalf of our partners to over 30,000 students across multiple disciplines with our 700+ globally located educators.

LINC is managed by education sector professionals with more than 50 years of combined experience and overseen by an advisory board of the best academic professionals in the world. Dr. Christopher Brook (Ex-Dean, Edith Cowan University and Curtin University), Dr. M Rammohan Rao (ex-Dean, Indian School of Business and ex-Director, IIM Bangalore) and Deepak Chandra (ex-Deputy Dean, Indian School of Business) are members of the LINC Board of Advisors.

In 2022,OES, Australia’s largest online education company, became one of our investors through which we joinedSEEK’s(SEK.AX) Education Portfolio

What’s on offer?

Selected applicants will be engaged as independent contractors and will be offered a competitive fixed remuneration of up to $6350 for a cohort of 25 students. Further upsides are available based on larger batch sizes as well as achievement-related increments of up to 20%.

Professional benefits include:

  • Interacting with and learning from with high-quality university faculty;

  • Working with a diverse range of international students;

  • Specialized training for online teaching and delivery

  • Active mentoring for professional growth

  • Improving interpersonal and cross-cultural skills

The role ispart-time(15-20 hours per week) with scheduled weekend availability. Educators will have the flexibility to work from a location of their convenience.

AI Driven Skills (Big Plus)

  • Clear communicator – You articulate ideas clearly, write well, and listen with intent. You create shared understanding.

  • Leads through influence – You raise the bar by mentoring others, setting standards, and sharing knowledge — not by authority.
  • Documentation-first thinker – You value written clarity, and help your team by documenting decisions, code, and processes.

Senior Data Analyst

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to help us change the way the world works. Here, you’ll be a key member of our Data Analytics team, where you will use your quantitative background to dive into large datasets to guide decision-making for the B2C Marketing team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about the Senior Data Analyst role and see if we’re destined to be together.

As a Senior Data Analyst you will:

  • Build a comprehensive understanding of how customers move through our digital ecosystem—from initial visit to purchase and beyond
  • Analyze and mitigate customer churn effectively while also driving strategies for customer acquisition and optimize trial-to-conversion processes
  • Make data driven strategy recommendations in these areas such as customer acquisition, customer activation and retention as well as media mix modeling, marketing attribution and experimentation
  • Deep dive into advanced analyses, providing robust models tied to business objectives and outcomes, and being able to derive meaningful conclusions from it
  • Ideate and implement unexplored analyses that can identify areas of opportunity that support business goals and evolve business strategy
  • Partner with business stakeholders and data engineering to define key metrics and build scalable, user-friendly dashboards that translate complex data into meaningful insights, drive adoption, and support strategic decision-making
  • Be able to work independently, identify dependencies to unblock projects, and craft courses of action to complete projects
  • Manage multiple complex projects in parallel tracks

What YOUBring to the Team:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Product Analytics, Revenue Analytics, Customer Analytics, Data Science, or related analytical field.
  • Advanced database and data transformation skills with preferred experience in Snowflake and dbt.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, data governance, and data quality best practices.
  • Strong expertise in data visualization, and dashboard development (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, etc.) with a proven ability to translate complex datasets into intuitive, actionable reporting for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in analyzing key customer pathways, surfacing friction points to identify where experimentation can improve flow and conversion
  • Proficiency in BigQuery, Google Analytics, advantages and limitations of GA4 event tracking and its effect on analytics

US:

  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.
  • Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we soappreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

raw.description:
ThreeTrader is looking for a hands-on AI & Marketing Automation Lead to design, build and continuously improve the AI and automation systems behind our marketing — across acquisition, content production, campaigns, client nurturing and analytics.

By connecting AI, our CRM, ad platforms and internal data, you will cut repetitive manual work, raise marketing efficiency and deliver measurable commercial results. Over time, you will build a scalable, semi-automated marketing function.

This is a builder-leader role. You will own process design, tool selection, delivery and team enablement — and you will be expected to implement, not just advise.

Key responsibilities

1. Set the marketing automation roadmap

  • Map current marketing processes, roles, tools and data sources, and identify where automation will pay off most.
  • Build 90-day and 12-month implementation plans, prioritised by business value, effort and risk.
  • Define which tasks AI performs, which require human review, and how exceptions are handled.

2. Build AI-powered marketing workflows

  • Create end-to-end workflows from brief and market research through drafting, asset production, review, publishing and performance review.
  • Support production and iteration of ad copy, email, landing pages, social content and Japanese-market content.
  • Build a brand knowledge base, content templates and quality checks so output is accurate and on-brand.
  • Make successful workflows reusable across the team, reducing reliance on any one person's know-how.

3. Integrate CRM and the client journey

  • Connect HubSpot, the client portal, ad platforms, website events and other business data.
  • Optimise journeys across registration, identity verification, first deposit, activation, retention and win-back.
  • Protect existing segments, journeys and historical records when systems or data integrations change.
  • Build deduplication, retries, logging, monitoring and alerting so automations run reliably.

4. Build analytics and optimisation capability

  • Align event definitions, lifecycle stages and marketing metrics with the marketing and engineering teams.
  • Automate channel and campaign reporting, flag data anomalies and recommend improvements.
  • Enable conversion and CAC analysis by channel, campaign and client segment.
  • Run before-and-after evaluations on every automation to prove hours saved and business impact.

5. Drive AI adoption across the team

  • Create clear playbooks, review standards and training materials for each role.
  • Help marketers build AI into their daily work and keep improving results.
  • Manage tools, vendors and implementation resources, keeping cost and system complexity in check.
  • Work with Marketing, Engineering and Compliance to govern client data access and publishing permissions.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years in Marketing Operations, Growth Engineering, CRM, marketing automation or systems integration.
  • 2+ years applying generative AI to real business workflows, with live examples you can show.
  • Led at least two cross-system automation projects end to end — requirements, build, launch and ongoing maintenance.
  • Strong grasp of the marketing funnel and how registration, verification, first deposit, activation and retention connect.
  • Hands-on HubSpot (or comparable CRM) implementation experience: workflows, properties, segmentation and event triggers.
  • Fluency with APIs, webhooks, JSON, data mapping and identity resolution; able to troubleshoot data issues between systems.
  • Can write integration logic in Python or JavaScript and use SQL to query and validate data.
  • Experience with at least one automation platform (n8n, Make or Zapier), and the judgement to know when low-code is enough and when custom development is needed.
  • Practical experience with generative AI APIs, structured outputs, retrieval over knowledge bases and output quality evaluation.
  • Able to design human review, exception handling and rollback so workflows stay under control.
  • Measures success in business outcomes, not tool usage or content volume.
  • Works effectively in English with marketing and engineering teams across regions.

Nice to have

  • Experience in FX, brokerage, fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Japanese-market or multilingual marketing experience.
  • Familiarity with ad tracking, web analytics, lifecycle marketing and attribution.
  • A track record of moving a marketing team from heavy manual work to standardised, automated workflows.
  • Experience managing technical teams or vendors, or leading cross-functional projects.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
  • Opportunity to own and shape creative direction in a high-growth market
  • A collaborative, international team culture with flat hierarchy
  • Modern office in Taichung with flexible working arrangements
  • Professional development budget and access to industry tools and resources
  • The chance to be part of a pivotal growth phase in the Asia-Pacific FinTech space

raw.description:
The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.

This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.

The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.

Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.

Clinical Quality

  • Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
    • Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.
    • Partner with COO, CFO, Network, Pharmacy, Stars, Risk Adjustment, and Operations leadership to ensure quality initiatives are coordinated enterprise-wide without assuming accountability for their respective programs.
    Accreditation
    • Own enterprise accreditation strategy and execution, including NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC, and other applicable state and federal accreditation or certification requirements.
    • Lead survey readiness, documentation, and corrective action planning for all accreditation activities.
    • Maintain accreditation standards as they evolve and ensure organizational readiness for renewal cycles.
    HEDIS Vendor Ecosystem Leadership
    • Serve as the executive owner of the vendor ecosystem supporting HEDIS data collection, medical record retrieval, abstraction, and supplemental data.
    • Consolidate and manage HEDIS vendors to reduce cost, improve data quality, and strengthen audit defensibility.
    • Establish unified SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance for HEDIS-related vendors.
    • Ensure vendors operate as extensions of the internal quality team.
    Quality Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
    • Ensure data quality, timeliness, and integration across clinical, operational, and vendor systems supporting quality measurement.
    • In partnership with Health Services Analytics, build a unified reporting architecture for HEDIS, accreditation, and clinical quality programs.
    Governance & Compliance
    • Ensure compliance with NCQA, URAC, and applicable regulatory requirements governing quality and accreditation.
    • Lead enterprise audit readiness for HEDIS and accreditation surveys.
    • Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and cross-functional alignment on quality matters.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of leadership experience in health plan Quality, HEDIS, and Accreditation, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.
• Proven track record of improving HEDIS rates and achieving strong NCQA/URAC accreditation outcomes.
• Deep knowledge of HEDIS technical specifications, NCQA accreditation standards, and clinical quality improvement methodology.
• Experience leading large cross-functional teams and complex vendor ecosystems, particularly HEDIS data and abstraction vendors.
• Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, ROI analysis, and budget management.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive enterprise-wide change.
• Master's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.

General Physical Demands: Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

What We Offer:

As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
    • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
    • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
    • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
    • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
    • Additional voluntary benefits available; and

• A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.
